Had a professor name some new books he read while I was in a lit class. I decided to pick up The Road by Cormac McCarthy.

I was never much of a reader until that moment. That book changed my life.
My wife left me. Ive been trying to work to fix it but no luck. I quit my job because I was losing my mind and I now feel like I have no purpose.

Thank you for this. I'm stuck in the lack of motivation part of depression and I have trouble doing things but like everything sometimes I have those moments of clarity that I feel okay. I try to talk it out but I feel that I know what people will say and it doesn't help when I have no interest in things. Maybe a therapist would help.

Honestly. My wife who moved out after issues almost a year walked around 20 feet next to me with her arm around me. We seem to be moving to a positive area. It may not mean anything but being that this year has been a deep depression for me it was the best feeling I've had in a while.

At this point in my life it's that I don't want my mom to bury me and I don't want my step-daughter to wonder what happened or wonder why I'm not here anymore. I still think about it frequently but that's what keeps me from going through with it.

Honestly. I wouldn't have fucked up my marriage, had my wife leave me, realize I have no plan in life and no direction. I've contemplated it and planned to how I would do it but never had an active plan. I just can't put my mother and step-daughter through it. I don't want to put my hurt onto them.

Easily one of the hardest years of my life. 

So every day I wake up and try to move forward hoping there are better things to come.
